attributes.title: 45th Annual National Pharmacy Technician Convention
attributes.series: AAPT Annual National Pharmacy Technician Convention
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Pharmacy Technicians holds its 45th national convention from July 29 to 31, 2027, at the Sundial Resort & Spa on Sanibel Island, Florida. People can attend on site or join virtually; virtual attendees get access to the session recordings for a short period afterwards.

AAPT advertises 9 continuing education credits for the convention. The convention page does not name the accrediting body or give ACPE activity numbers, so check the CE details with AAPT if your state board needs ACPE-accredited hours.

The full package was listed at $385 (marked down from $490) when we checked, with a $90 discount for Elite members and a group offer for teams. A $75 guest pass covers meals and amenities but no CE. Hotel rates and a detailed schedule were not published yet.
